origin: cwe/862/php Key Principles: for resource-specific actions compare the authenticated user to the model instance, not just check a role

finding.name: Missing Authorization
finding.summary: index() intends admins to see every order and other users to see only their own, but the two return statements are on the wrong side of the isAdmin() check: any non-admin, authenticated user hits the Order::all() branch and receives every user's orders, while admins get the owner-scoped query.

trap: Adding abort_unless($user->isAdmin(), 403) before Order::all() (or blocking non-admins from index() entirely with middleware) makes the branch admin-only but removes the endpoint's self-service list for every non-admin caller, which was never the intent. The branches themselves are simply swapped: Order::all() belongs behind if ($user->isAdmin()), and Order::where('user_id', $user->id)->get() belongs in the else - the fix is correcting which return sits in which branch, not adding a new gate.
must_preserve: Admin users still receive every Order from this endpoint. Non-admin users receive only orders where user_id matches their own id, and never another user's orders.
